description: A PHP class extending SugarView that manages the rendering and processing of a wizard interface for ModuleBuilder in SuiteCRM, including handling different views such as layouts, subpanels, search, dashlets, and popups, with various methods for button generation and view processing.

classes.name: ModuleBuilderViewWizard
classes.description: A PHP class extending SugarView that manages the rendering and processing of a wizard interface for ModuleBuilder in SuiteCRM, including handling different views such as layouts, subpanels, search, dashlets, and popups, with various methods for button generation and view processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes view and module parameters from request data.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array used to generate the module title parameters, including the module name and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the wizard interface by preparing Smarty variables and injecting content via AjaxCompose.

methods.name: processStudio
methods.description: Processes and prepares the interface forStudio views including module, layout, subpanel, search, dashlet, and popup views.

methods.name: processMB
methods.description: Processes and prepares the ModuleBuilder views, handling different subviews such as search, subpanel, dashlet, popup, or layout.

methods.name: generateStudioModuleButtons
methods.description: Generates buttons for Studio modules using StudioBrowser.

methods.name: generateMBViewButtons
methods.description: Creates a set of buttons for different layout views in ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: generateMBDashletButtons
methods.description: Creates buttons related to dashlet views in ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: generateMBPopupButtons
methods.description: Generates buttons for popup views in ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: generateStudioDashletButtons
methods.description: Generates dashlet buttons for Studio modules.

methods.name: generateStudioPopupButtons
methods.description: Generates popup buttons for Studio modules.
